0.long_answer: Reactive thrombocytosis can be observed when the body responds to an inflammatory process. Inflammation is characterized by redness, heat, swelling, pain, and loss of function. These signs occur as the body’s immune system reacts to injury, infection, or other harmful stimuli by releasing cytokines and various mediators. These signaling molecules, in turn, stimulate the bone marrow to increase the production of platelets, resulting in elevated platelet counts.
